# `mise bootstrap plugins apply`

- **用法：** `mise bootstrap plugins apply [-n --dry-run]`
- **效果：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

安装在 `[bootstrap.plugins]` 中声明的包管理器插件

It does not ask for confirmation.

## Flags
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show which plugins would be installed without installing them
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
